Name: Multiple Sprites and Portraits On Rotation
Author: SlyMerc
Description:
[size=3]Ever wanted your villagers to look different based on the season? Or to have a villager's hair grow, or gain a tan? Or maybe you couldn't decide between two different sprites for a villager?

Use this simple SMAPI mod to easily accomplish all of those!

This mod works by placing the .png files of the characters' sprites and portraits into folders and then rotating through them based upon the inputs of a config file. You can have them change daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly. Don't want to have them change based on day, but rather on friendship level? The option to have them switch based on gaining a friendship level is also there!

A readme file is included to help explain the inputs.

Start using this mod to make your villagers more dynamic in appear!

Version 1.1:
Added feature that allowed sprites/portraits to change whether it is raining or not.
Added feature that allowed sprites/portraits to change whether they are inside or outside.
[/size]
